GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT COLLECTOR AND MAGISTRATE;
NIZAMABAD DISTRICT
NOTIFICATION
Ref: No.2835/E-I/RDDW/NZB/2026
Date:_26_/10/2026
Sub: Department of AYUSH – National AYUSH Mission - Engaging various
categories of services on outsourcing basis to carry out AYUSH
Public Health Programmes in Nizamabad District on
outsourcing basis to work under the administrative control of
Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad up to
31/3/2027 –Regarding.
****
Government vide G.O.Rt.No.1508, Fin (HRM.VII) Dept., Dt:21/08/2026
have accord permission for (333) various categories of services i.e. , thirty eight
(38) services on contract and two hundred and ninety five (295) services on
outsourcing basis, the Director, Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad have
requested the Collector & District Magistrate, Nizamabad District to fill up only
(08) posts in (6) categories which are sanctioned in Nizamabad District through
District Selection Committee (DSC) as the posts are exclusively meant for AYUSH
Department under Public Health Programme in National AYUSH Mission.
Hence, Applications are invited for the following posts to work on
outsourcing basis under AYUSH Public Health Programmes in Nizamabad
District up to 31.03.2027 under the administrative control of Director,
Department of AYUSH, T.G., Secunderabad.
The applications will be received for the above said posts from
Dt: _27-10-2026____________ to Dt: ___03-11-2026______________ between
10:30 AM to 05:00 PM (on working days). Applications are to be submitted
in person or through Registered Post at Romm No 201,District Medical and
Health Office O/o: Collector and District Magistrate,Dubba Nizamabad
District.503001. The applications, which are received after the due date
(i.e., Dt: _03-11-2026____________), will be summarily
rejected. District Selection Committee is not responsible for the postal
delays.
The remuneration and educational qualifications prescribed for the
respective categories shall be as specified in the approved guidelines and
Government Orders.
I. METHOD OF RECRUITMENT:
The recruitment is to be made on outsourcing basis up to 31.03.2027 and
thereafter the services will be as per the need and also subject to satisfactory
performance.
The recruitment shall be done by the District Selection Committee of the
District Health Society.
The District Selection Committee shall consist of the following members:
a) District Collector : Chairman
2
b) Concerned Regional Deputy Director,
Department of AYUSH : Member /
Convener
c) DMHO : Member
d) Deputy Director Social Welfare : Member
e) DCHS : Member
f) AYUSH District Nodal Officer : Member
Selections will be done based on the following criteria
a) Total Marks are 100 of which 90 marks will be allotted basing on the marks
obtained in qualifying examination for AYUSH Doctor with PG
Qualification, AYUSH Medical Officer, Pharmacists, Dieticians,
Psychosocial Counselor and Yoga Professional.
b) For all the posts, (10) marks will be awarded for the age. Weightage for age
will be reckoned from 18 years of age of the candidate 0.5 mark will be
awarded for one completed year of age with a maximum of 10 marks. The
age will be reckoned as on 1.7.2026 (Example 1, If a candidate completes
20 years as on 1.7.2026, he will be awarded 1.0 mark; Example 2. If a
candidate completes 30 years of age as on 1.7.2026, he/she will be
awarded 6.0 marks, Example 3. If a candidate completes 40 years of age
as on 1.7.2026, he/she will be awarded 10.0 marks).
c) Merit list will be prepared based on the marks obtained with above
criteria and displayed on website for transparency.
d) Selection list will be prepared from the finalized merit list duly following
the rule of reservation and Presidential Order.
e) For Psychosocial Counselor, a panel of eligible candidates may be
empaneled. The empaneled candidates shall be engaged on a call basis,
as and when their services are required.

5
The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years. The
minimum and maximum age shall be reckoned as on 01/07/2026 with the
following relaxations allowed for reckoning the maximum age limit as per
rules:
i. For S.C’s, S.T’s & BC’s 5 (Five) years.
ii. For Ex-Service man 3 (Three) years in addition to the length of service
in armed forces.
iii. Disable persons 10 (ten) years.
VI. RULE OF RESERVATION:
Rules of Reservation in respect of Community, Disability, Ex-service Men
shall be strictly observed as per the Telangana State and Subordinate Service
Rules, 1996, read with the relevant Specific Rules applicable.
The Rule of Reservation of Local candidates is applicable as per
Presidential order.

a) Application forms along with the instructions can be downloaded from

District. Applications which are received after due dates will be summarily
rejected. District Selection Committee is not responsible for postal delays.
